title: Turkish Delight Bao
description: A sweet and unique dessert that combines the warmth of Turkish Delight with the softness of Bao.
instructions: Roll out the bao dough to a thickness of about 1 cm.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a small spoonful of Turkish Delight in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the bao with coconut oil and sprinkle with granulated sugar.
Place the bao on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the bao are golden brown.
Let the bao cool for a few minutes before serving.
